description_en: Imports one or more do-not-call numbers to a specified instance. You can import numbers by manual entry or file upload
description_zh: 调用ImportDoNotCallNumbers向指定实例下导入一个或多个禁止外呼号码，导入方式包括手动录入和文件上传两种方式
kebab_example: aliyun ccc import-do-not-call-numbers --instance-id ccc-test --number-list 19000000000_,_13121210000 --remark '测试' --file-path temp/blacklist/import/15772471154xxxx/ccc-test/20220315100340/blacklist.xlsx --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ImportDoNotCallNumbers

parameters.description_en: A JSON string that represents an array of do-not-call numbers.
parameters.description_zh: 禁止外呼号码列表，格式为JSON数组的字符串，数组元素是禁呼号码。
parameters.help_en: A JSON string that represents an array of do-not-call numbers
parameters.help_zh: 禁止外呼号码列表，格式为JSON数组的字符串，数组元素是禁呼号码
parameters.name: number_list

parameters.description_en: The remark for the do-not-call numbers.
parameters.help_en: The remark for the do-not-call numbers
parameters.name: remark

parameters.description_en: The key of the OSS file. You can obtain the key from the response of the GetDoNotCallFileUploadParameters API. This parameter is required only for file uploads.
parameters.description_zh: OSS文件的Key，可从GetDoNotCallFileUploadParameters接口返回值中获取，仅在文件上传方式导入时需要填写此参数。
parameters.help_en: The key of the OSS file. You can obtain the key from the response of the GetDoNotCallFileUploadParameters API. This parameter is required only for file uploads
parameters.help_zh: OSS文件的Key，可从GetDoNotCallFileUploadParameters接口返回值中获取，仅在文件上传方式导入时需要填写此参数
parameters.name: file_path
